_description: Dual-signal QS integration in V. cholerae: CAI-1 + AI-2 converge on LuxO/HapR to control c-di-GMP and biofilm
_groundspring_question: When two noisy input signals are integrated through a shared pathway, does the combined SNR improve or degrade?

model._description: 7-variable ODE: [cell, CAI-1, AI-2, LuxO~P, HapR, c-di-GMP, biofilm]. Default barracuda MultiSignalParams.

analytical_predictions._description: At steady state: cell → capacity, both AIs produced, HapR activated (represses LuxO~P), biofilm forms. Signal integration: dual-signal should produce higher HapR and more biofilm than single-signal alone.

expected_results.dual_signal_variance_ratio_max_rationale: Dual-signal c-di-GMP std must be at most 1.5x single-signal std; signal integration reduces noise.
